accentPalettes.storage: one shared preset per space in space.yml, owner-written through PATCH /api/spaces/{space}; the v0.4 browser-local key seeds it once, then is deleted
accentPalettes.contrastFloor: 4.5:1 accent-on-ground and ink-on-accent in both schemes, enforced by web/src/lib/accent.test.ts

surfaces.commandPalette: Bottom sheet below sm, 40rem centred above; one search row, grouped results, 44px rows on coarse pointers; keyboard footer only on keyboard screens; focus trapped and returned.
surfaces.quickCapture: Two-mode sheet, 34rem wide; type, title, required properties only; Create keeps the sheet, Create and open navigates; refusals stay inline with Retry.
surfaces.bulkBar: Hairline band inside the table scrollport, not a floating card; names count and property, previews the value, keeps failed rows selected, Undo runs from the page.
surfaces.rowActions: Line icons at one weight; 32px fine pointer, 44px coarse; phones fold Complete/Duplicate/Trash into one 44px menu and keep Open separate.
surfaces.mobileSheets: Palette, capture, space drawer and row menu rise from the bottom; safe-area padding; focus trap; Escape and a close control; content and footer reserve room for the fixed space bar, which carries the space menu plus direct Capture and palette actions.
surfaces.tablePhones: Below 640px the checkbox stays pinned, the title scrolls, and the action cell is Open plus a menu; property columns remain swipeable.
surfaces.addProperty: A ruled dialog from the trailing table header or the Columns panel: an existing library property or a new name and format; property, type member (featured) and current-view column write in order, staying open with a named stage and Retry on failure. Editor-only, no wizard, one toast on success.
surfaces.recordIcons: One optional user-authored emoji in frontmatter (schema 4), never a property or interface icon. A fixed slot in the record header, table title cell, home recents, palette results, board cards, gallery tiles and Trash; absent means no empty box.
surfaces.sheetClose: Right-handed keeps the platform-standard trailing close; left-handed puts the same control first in the title or search row, with focus order and margin following the DOM.

display.purpose: Auth titles and page headings; one per screen.

body.purpose: Prose, form values and row names.

label.purpose: Column headers, field labels, roles and keys; uppercase mono.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One entrance on a page's main content; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one stateful action on a view: sign in, create account, create space.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; padding:10px 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); color:var(--color-accent-ink,#14180f); font-family:var(--font-sans,'IBM Plex Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:filter 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: sign out, retry, cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--color-line,#2d332d); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink,#e8ece4); font-family:var(--font-sans,'IBM Plex Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--color-raised,#212621); border-color:var(--color-line-strong,#3a423a); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled input with hint and error slots.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font-family:var(--font-sans,'IBM Plex Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-family:var(--font-mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace); font-size:11px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-muted,#9aa398); } .ds-input { height:40px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--color-line,#2d332d); border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-ground,#121512); color:var(--color-ink,#e8ece4); font:400 15px/1.5 var(--font-sans,'IBM Plex Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--color-line-strong,#3a423a); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-faint,#747d72); }

components.name: App Header
components.description: The signed-in navigation: wordmark at left, account and sign-out at right.
components.html: thingyou@example.com
components.css: .ds-header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; height:64px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line,#2d332d); font-family:var(--font-sans,'IBM Plex Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; font-family:var(--font-mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace); font-size:15px; color:var(--color-ink,#e8ece4); text-decoration:none; } .ds-mark { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); } .ds-email { font-family:var(--font-mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace); font-size:12px; color:var(--color-muted,#9aa398); }

components.name: Space Index Entry
components.description: The signature row: mono key, name, counts, role, and an annotation that opens beneath it.
components.html: Garden10OWNER
components.css: .ds-entry { display:grid; grid-template-columns:80px minmax(0,1fr) 64px 64px 96px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line,#2d332d); font-family:var(--font-sans,'IBM Plex Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-entry-key, .ds-entry-count, .ds-entry-role { font-family:var(--font-mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace); font-size:11px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-muted,#9aa398); } .ds-entry-key { background:none; border:0; padding:0; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-entry-key:hover { color:var(--color-accent,#c8d96b); } .ds-entry-name { font-size:17px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.01em; color:var(--color-ink,#e8ece4); text-decoration:none; } .ds-entry-name:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-entry-count { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-entry-role { text-align:right; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a field index read under a headlamp: dark ground, hairline rules, keys in mono, annotations in the margin. It treats the user's data the way a naturalist treats a specimen sheet — the record is the subject; the apparatus around it stays small, aligned and quiet. The product is a working tool first. The world contributes type, palette, density and one signature move (the keyed entry), never the navigation model or the controls.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground with near-neutral, slightly green-black surfaces.
Hairline 1px rules instead of shadows or cards.
Mono for keys, ids, timestamps and counts; sans for prose and controls.
One accent per space, chosen by an owner from six contrast-tested palettes and shared by every member, used only for state (selection, focus, primary action); Lichen is the default.
A keyed index as the recurring structure: a short mono key leads every entry.
On phones, navigation and sheets live at the bottom, within thumb reach; keyboard-only affordances are absent.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The chosen accent (Lichen by default) marks state: focus, selection, the primary action, the wordmark, the active rail and view tabs. An owner sets it once for the space; every member sees it. It never fills large areas and never appears twice in one row for two different meanings. Choosing another palette does not add a second accent.

rules.name: The Light Is Not a Theme Skin Rule
rules.body: Light mode keeps the same type scale, rules and hierarchy. It swaps the ground to bone and darkens the accent for contrast; it does not add shadows, cards or new ornament.

rules.name: The Keys Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything the system treats as an identifier or measurement is mono and tabular. Anything a person reads as a sentence is sans.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A divider is 1px of line. Never a 2px border, never a colored side stripe, never a shadow standing in for a rule.

rules.name: The Thumb First Rule
rules.body: Below lg the rail and every overlay rise from the bottom of the screen, with 44px targets and safe-area padding. A keyboard shortcut that has no keyboard is not rendered. A compact editor's primary action sits at the thumb edge: last in the DOM at the right edge by default and first in the DOM at the left edge in left-handed mode, with clear/cancel before it on the right and after it on the left. The row reverses in the DOM so paint, Tab and screen-reader order agree. Dialog and sheet close controls follow the same handedness; the platform-standard trailing close is the right-handed default.

dos: Do keep the chosen accent to state and the wordmark; if it is not saying selected, focused or primary action, it is the wrong color.
Do use mono for keys, ids, counts, timestamps and labels, and tabular numerals for every number.
Do separate rows and sections with 1px hairlines and spacing, not cards or shadows.
Do name the next action in empty states and errors, in the product's own language.
Do keep the signed-out margin notes factual: they describe what the files and schema are.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, glass, gradients, glows or colored side stripes.
Don't fill large surfaces with the accent or introduce a second accent.
Don't use emoji as interface icons; they belong only to user-authored space icons.
Don't turn the index into a card grid, add a sidebar before the space exists, or hide the create action behind a modal.
Don't set prose in mono or identifiers in sans.
